plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's growth. The square puts them in friction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
This person may push you to think bigger than you normally do.

They may see opportunities, strengths, or possibilities that you have not fully claimed for yourself yet. Their instinct is often to encourage growth, but their enthusiasm can sometimes feel like pressure if it moves faster than your readiness or capacity.

When this works, being around them can make the future feel less fixed. They have a way of opening doors in your thinking, helping you imagine options you had dismissed or desires you had talked yourself out of wanting. Their presence can make you more willing to trust your own potential and take a step toward something larger than what feels familiar.

That can be incredibly valuable. Sometimes another person's belief arrives right when you have started treating your limits as facts. They may challenge assumptions you have made about what is possible for you and encourage you to take yourself more seriously than you usually do.

The harder part is knowing when encouragement is helping you grow and when it is asking too much of you. Their enthusiasm may pull you toward choices that feel exciting but not entirely right, or toward a pace that leaves little room to catch your breath. What feels motivating one day can feel overwhelming the next if there is not enough space for your own timing and needs.

Don't confuse possibility with pressure. Let them push you to think bigger, but don't lose track of your own timing, priorities, or limits. This works best when their encouragement helps you grow without talking you into something you can't actually sustain.
